request.query:
mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {
  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

dedupe.disposition: AddDomain write normalization and mobile rule editor sizing, neither covers inbound static Host lookup.

transportNotes: Native HTTP receipts retain full response bodies and selected content-type/content-length/location headers, not an unrestricted header dump.
Go requestHost records Request.Host, not a packet capture; curl wireHosts is extracted from verbose Host/authority output.
GraphQL request objects were POSTed to https://api.bex.co/graphql using the authenticated QA browser context.
Fixtures and public Render URLs were read without custom Host overrides or disabled TLS verification; no credentials are present in replay sources.
replayInstructions: Create a fresh owned Free no-build static fixture from the captured native CreateService request, supplying a new qa-prefixed name; wait for Live.
Substitute that new fixture hostname for the deleted a585 hostname in each replay source, preserve lower/upper/mixed spellings, and run the Python and Go sources.
Replay helpers do public reads only. Delete the new fixture and revoke only its own QA session after verification.
